item.title: WebKit Features for Safari 26.5
item.content:encoded: Safari 26.5 is here, delivering the :open pseudo-class, the element-scoped keyword for random(), color-interpolation for SVG gradients, the ToggleEvent.source property for popovers, and the Origin API.
